categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, design, and sales of high-speed wired communication chips, focusing on Ethernet physical layer chips as the market entry point and gradually expanding to upper-layer network processing products. It has established seven product lines including network Ethernet physical layer chips, Ethernet switch chips, Ethernet network card chips, automotive Ethernet physical layer chips, automotive Ethernet switch chips, automotive gateway chips, and automotive high-speed video transmission chips. The products serve multiple sectors such as data communication, security, consumer electronics, telecommunications, industrial, and automotive fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chip design technologies including high-performance SerDes, ADC/DAC design, digital equalizers, echo cancellation, low-jitter PLL, SOC chip integration, and communication security technologies like MACsec. It uses a fabless model outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to leading industry partners. The R&D process is market-driven and technology-led, with structured project management and cross-functional teams ensuring product quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include system integrators and end-users in telecommunications, data centers, industrial automation, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, and security sectors. Major end markets encompass routers, switches, industrial control systems, smart home devices, automotive advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and intelligent cockpit systems. The company has established relationships with prominent domestic and international clients such as Xiaomi, H3C, and various automotive OEMs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and R&D centers in Suzhou and Shanghai, and has expanded overseas with a development center in Singapore. It serves domestic markets extensively and has begun penetrating multiple overseas supply chains, achieving significant overseas revenue growth. The geographic focus includes key Chinese industrial and automotive hubs and expanding global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Operating as a fabless semiconductor design company, the company focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and service providers. It occupies a midstream position in the semiconductor supply chain, bridging upstream manufacturing and downstream system integration and end-user applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on expanding product lines in Ethernet physical layer chips, multi-port Ethernet switch chips, automotive Ethernet chips, and high-speed video transmission chips. It actively participates in international and national standard-setting bodies, collaborates with academic institutions, and pursues innovation in 2.5G, 5G/10G Ethernet, and automotive Ethernet technologies. The strategic roadmap includes developing 5G/10G Ethernet chips, automotive gateway chips, and time synchronization chips, aiming for breakthroughs in high-speed wired communication.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct and distributor sales of semiconductor chips, including Ethernet physical layer chips, switch chips, and network interface cards. The company also earns income from wafer sales, IP licensing, and technical service contracts based on custom chip design and development. Sales channels include both direct sales to end customers and buyout sales through distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in high-speed wired communication chips, particularly in Ethernet physical layer chips and automotive Ethernet chips, competing against established international giants who dominate the global market. It is one of the few Chinese firms achieving scale production of 2.5G Ethernet physical layer chips and integrated Ethernet switch chips. The company leverages local market knowledge and close customer relationships to gain competitive advantage in China while expanding globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Founded in 2017, the company has rapidly expanded its workforce to 348 employees with over 67% in R&D. In 2023, it reported revenue of approximately RMB 273.5 million, a 32.13% decrease from 2022 due to macroeconomic and industry downturns, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 150 million. Despite short-term revenue decline, the company shows sequential quarterly revenue growth and expects significant revenue recovery and growth from 2024 onwards driven by new product launches and market demand recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, stability, and advanced technology in its high-speed wired communication chips, offering a broad product portfolio covering commercial, industrial, and automotive-grade chips with various transmission speeds and port counts. It differentiates through strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, compliance with international automotive safety standards (ASIL D), and localized customer support. Its products have zero reported failure rates in customer production batches and have received multiple industry awards, positioning it as a trusted supplier in China’s strategic semiconductor sector.
